name: external_dependency_failure
description: Alerts on recurring database, vector database (Qdrant/LanceDB), or health check errors

query_condition.sql: SELECT count(*) as total, CASE WHEN str_match(body, 'Qdrant') OR str_match(error, 'VectorDbError') THEN 'qdrant_error' WHEN str_match(body, 'LanceDB') THEN 'lancedb_error' WHEN str_match(body, 'Gemini') OR str_match(body, 'AI API') THEN 'llm_api_error' ELSE COALESCE(event_type, 'unknown') END as error_category FROM "default" WHERE service_name IN ('scribe-backend', 'scribe_backend') AND (event_type IN ('database_error', 'qdrant_error', 'health_check_failure', 'ai_error', 'llm_error') OR (severity = 'ERROR' AND (str_match(body, 'Qdrant') OR str_match(error, 'VectorDbError') OR str_match(body, 'LanceDB') OR str_match(error, 'LanceDB') OR str_match(body, 'Gemini') OR str_match(body, 'AI API')))) GROUP BY error_category HAVING count(*) > 3
